notes: Both algorithms use exactly the same nearest-previous-identical-character matching; only the cutoff changes.
fixed_origin_cutoff maintains original query position for every hop, whereas occurrence-aware updates it to the last selected match value position.
Fixed-cutoff surrogate is NOT an exact BLN implementation, but shows losing occurrence location alone can break the compositional lookup even with perfect lexical matching.
The position-carrying oracle is a hard-coded binary lookup reference, not a trainable architecture result.
